integrity: Fully stated analytic proof and exact, independently replayable finite checks; finite enumeration does not certify the general theorem. Literature novelty is subject to unindexed equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: Real finite connected simple unit-edge graph metrics only. A sharp common lower bound, not each exact nonbipartite index; does not address weighted, complex, infinite, or general metrics.
title: A sharp universal half bound for numerical indices of finite graph free spaces
